target: mean reported hectares per accepted fire
purpose: Descriptive training-only sensitivity to dated coarse forest structure, with width and time-trend controls; no final-model promotion
height_join: Latest coarse SCANFI epoch strictly before the annual example; common-footprint mean from nearest 480m samples. No per-fire outcome-conditioned join.

rbf.gamma: inverse median positive training squared distance

qsvr.kernel: actual FidelityQuantumKernel, analytic local QMLSampler, enforce_psd=False

preprocessing: Training-only median imputation and standardization. Target log1p then training standardization; inverse to nonnegative hectares.
metrics: kernel effective rank/off-diagonal mean and width-placebo difference
interpretation: Four vs five qubits is an architectural change, even if the new feature is constant: ZZ interactions can change the kernel.
Ridge/RBF zero-column invariance is an arithmetic control.
Year control tests whether height merely supplies a temporal proxy.
Development folds have already been inspected; results are descriptive, not independent confirmation.
SCANFI full-series LandTrendr reconstruction uses later imagery: no as-of forecast claim.
No 2019–2024 labels or final records are opened; no adaptive retuning or model promotion.
